subject: Mental Models
title: Failure Mode Analysis
description: Learn Failure Mode Analysis in one minute.

hook.text: NASA's O-ring failed in cold weather and Challenger exploded.

buildup.text: Failure mode analysis asks: how can each component fail, what is the probability, and what is the consequence?

discovery.text: You rank each failure by severity and likelihood. The highest-risk items get fixed first, not the easiest ones.

twist.text: Most failures are not dramatic single points.

climax.text: Map failure chains, not just failure points.

punchline.text: Map how things break before they break. Fix the chain, not one link.

quiz.question: What does failure mode analysis prioritize?
options: Failures ranked by severity and likelihood
